content: One, two, three. Each thing you point at gets the next number.
The counting numbers go on forever. There is no last one.
Adding is counting on from where you already are.
Addition is the binary operation defined by recursion on the successor function, with the group structure this induces.
Things wear out. A cup can crack. A toy can stop working.
When you drop it, it falls. The dropping came first and made the falling happen.
One thing causes another, which causes another. Following the chain backwards is how you find where it began.
A bicycle is made of parts. If one part fails the whole bicycle may stop.
A part can fail in more than one way, and each way has different consequences.
Following a causal chain backwards from a failure reaches a condition whose correction would have prevented it. That condition is the root cause.
On Popper's account a root cause is identified by attempting to refute candidate explanations rather than by accumulating support for one.
Under a constant-hazard assumption the simulated fleet reaches ten percent cumulative failure at 4,200 hours.
Some conditions sit dormant in a system for years, harmless alone, and combine with a trigger to produce a failure. They are present before the accident and are not its trigger.
On the blameless-postmortem position, an investigation that assigns individual fault suppresses the reporting it depends on, and should therefore avoid doing so.
